services.name: Swimming in the Dolphin and Manatee Lagoon – Cocoa Beach Wildlife Tour
Dolphins in Cocoa Beach
services.desc: Do not hesitate to give us a call. We are an expert team, and we are happy to talk to you. Swimming in the Dolphin and Manatee Lagoon is our flagship 2-hour dolphin and manatee tour near Cocoa Beach, designed for guests who want to experience Florida wildlife in a natural, respectful way. Led by an experienced local captain, this small-group boat tour focuses on spotting wild dolphins and manatees in the lagoon where they live, with most of the experience taking place on the water as we cruise through their natural habitat. services.name: Private Sunset Cruise
services.desc: Do not hesitate to give us a call. We are an expert team, and we are happy to talk to you. Come unwind with us on this relaxing two-hour boat ride to see one of Florida’s beautiful sunsets on the water. Just your group aboard being chauffeured by one of our knowledgeable captains. We start the tour cruising through the lagoon in search of local wildlife such as dolphins, manatees, and coastal birds. Then watch as the sky transforms from blue to a colourful mix of purple, pink, and orange. Feel free to bring your drinks and snacks- no glass please! Tours include stories about rockets, local history, and the lagoon, suitable for kids and adults. Tours operate near Port Canaveral and Cocoa Beach, minutes from cruise terminals and Orlando.
